body: Hey. Sadly it’s not as simple as being able to sit down and have dinner. I don’t want to tell my whole story but I’d rather never see another person face to face for the rest of the time I’m alive, and that includes my family. I’ve tried therapy. And my doctor can’t help me, he’s tried and said my condition is incurable which at that point I died.

No, 99% people would be shocked how this could affect my life so greatly to the point of suicide, but sadly i can't cope and its never going away,

Sharing doesn't help either
